name: GoalMeter - Navy Chrome With Campaign Link
description: The progress band's new navy-and-gold chrome: gold kicker, white serif heading, and the View the campaign link sharing the heading's row. The meter area beneath is EMPTY on purpose — Givebutter's loader never runs inside a capture, so this frame proves the chrome we own and cannot prove their progress bar. The harness page forces the band visible past its own collapse-until-defined guard to produce a capture at all.
